history.summary: Zyanya is a tiny 34-unit freehold boutique on Lorong 25A Geylang (TOP 2025), well located 310m from Aljunied MRT but structurally illiquid. At $2.046M / $2000 PSF the 3BR sits right at the project's own URA median ($2015), with a weak new-launch-biased appreciation rate of just 1.5%/yr.
history.rating_rationale: Strong points: freehold, 310m to Aljunied MRT, D14 Paya Lebar Central catalyst. But the 34-unit size means almost no amenities, shallow resale pool and dependence on a handful of buyers; the URA rate is only 1.5%/yr (new-launch biased, 34 txns) and PSF $2000 is at median, so no value cushion. Geylang-fringe stigma further caps appreciation and the small dev red flag is real.
red_flags: Only 34 units — illiquid, minimal facilities, very shallow resale pool
URA appreciation just 1.5%/yr with new-launch bias
Priced at median PSF — no margin of safety
catalysts: Freehold tenure in an RCR district
Paya Lebar Central / airbase relocation transformation

agent_evaluation.appreciation_assessment: Capped: boutique freehold in Geylang appreciates slowly; the 1.5% URA rate (new-launch biased) understates but the real resale-to-resale figure for a 34-unit project will be modest. Do not override upward — thin data.
